about: How the organization's repositories depend on each other and touch: the interfaces (a vendored library, a reusable workflow, a GitHub App, a runner, data handed on) and the systems outside GitHub they reach. The control panel's Organization tab draws this file beside what it reads live from GitHub (the repositories, their open issues, the cross-repository blocked-by links of the open repository). Written 2026-10-29 from each repository's README, workflows, VENDORED record and the memory of this repository; docs/research/organization-map.md says how it was made and how to keep it. A repository's visibility is GitHub's word for it: public, internal (the enterprise's members) or private.
edge_reads: from depends on to: the repository named first takes, calls, reads, runs on or is served by the one named second

kinds.sync: opens the pull requests that bring each release into
kinds.app: acts through the GitHub App whose key it holds
kinds.data: takes its data or records from
kinds.tasks: has open tasks blocked by issues of
kinds.serves: is the service or the tool of
kinds.drives: drives through GitHub's API as the signed-in person

groups.spine: The spine science: SchwingNet and the repositories it reads and feeds
groups.symphony: Symphony: the claim protocol, its template, Apps, front door, plugin, extension, benchmarks and site
groups.beethoven: Beethoven: a Claude Code worker on a university cluster, its clients, services and engine

nodes.name: SchwingNet
nodes.role: The next SchwingNet as a workflow that grows: vertebral level naming on fluoroscopy, built through Symphony's claim protocol; the shared plane of every account's Project.

nodes.name: bordercall
nodes.role: Name a vertebral border from the shape of the bone, with no count from C2; run over the census's SPINEPS masks on the grid from SchwingNet's gate word.

nodes.name: spine-program
nodes.role: The root working context: thirteen numbered project folders (the reported SchwingNet, the transitional truth, CTSpinoPelvic1K, the toolkit, the census, the plain films, the renders, the QI, the data platform, students, the site and PACS demo, AIDaS), each self-contained, worked by the claim protocol; the record material is on the grid.

nodes.name: spine-datasets
nodes.role: The unheld datasets obtained with collaborators: one record and one issue per set, the request letters, the storage plan on its branch storage-feed, the tracks for paired data, synthesis, workflow and growth.

nodes.name: spine-detector
nodes.role: The multi-source spine radiograph corpus and the vertebra corner detector: the X-ray counterpart of CTSpinoPelvic1K.

nodes.name: CTSpinoPelvic1K
nodes.role: Spine, pelvis, ribs and femora in one frame, annotated for lumbosacral transitional anatomy: the release's build pipeline, quality control and paper.

nodes.name: OpenSpineToolkit
nodes.role: Tested geometry primitives and spinopelvic measurements for CTSpinoPelvic1K masks.

nodes.name: spinopelvic-seg
nodes.role: nnU-Net v2 training and inference code for the CTSpinoPelvic1K segmentation checkpoints.

nodes.name: FleXray
nodes.role: A fork read for the audit the owner's brief of 2026-10-25 asks for first (SchwingNet#391) and for the DRR renderer the domain-gap study replicates.

nodes.name: FLUX-REALISM
nodes.role: A fork read for the FluXray reproduction (zero-shot FLUX.2 over MOOSE DRRs).

nodes.name: PlotNeuralNet
nodes.role: A fork of the LaTeX network-diagram template the brief names for the regenerated network figure.

nodes.name: symphony-protocol
nodes.role: The claim protocol as one Python package with no dependencies: the labels, the claim, the board, the coordinator, the registry of workers, the protocol check, the clerk, the push guard and the merge gate; its ecosystem.json names every consumer and the modules each takes; the lessons and notebooks live here.

nodes.name: symphony-template
nodes.role: The template a Claude project is made from, kept as files: instructions, memory, board, and the workflows and hooks that run the protocol; the grid key route, the token pool, the drive and papers workflows, the research programmes of Symphony itself.

nodes.name: symphony-app
nodes.role: The backend of the GitHub App SymphonyBoard (and the setup App): installation tokens that start a new copy's first workflows, auto-merge and settings runs, the sign-in Worker the control panel uses, the metrics collector and the panel's own checks.

nodes.name: symphony-start
nodes.role: The front door: one form adopts the template into a new or existing repository; the Apps' privacy statement lives here.

nodes.name: symphony-marketplace
nodes.role: The Claude Code plugin marketplace with one plugin, symphony: the skills, /board and the hooks for a repository not made from the template.

nodes.name: symphony-extension
nodes.role: Symphony for Chrome: the buttons on github.com that create or migrate a repository through the Apps' install link and the front door's form.

nodes.name: symphony-protocol-canary
nodes.role: The repository the protocol's release workflow runs each release against before it is published.

nodes.name: test
nodes.role: A copy of the template kept for trying the front door and the workflows.

nodes.name: coordbench
nodes.role: The playground and benchmark comparing ways of coordinating Claude Code agents on CooperBench's task pairs, the claim protocol's merge gate among them.

nodes.name: flowbench
nodes.role: The workflow as a plug-in, measured on SWE-bench Verified: one agent alone, a script of phases, or the claim protocol; its running notes stay in symphony-template.

nodes.name: openspineconsortium.github.io
nodes.role: The public site, built by tools/build_site.py from the sibling repositories' texts: the lab page, Symphony and Beethoven, the control panel that drives any Symphony repository as the signed-in person, and the cost page.

nodes.name: beethoven
nodes.role: The project hub: no product code, but the hand-off state, the build plan and ledger, the shared-code design, the project's memory and the map of the Beethoven repositories and where they touch.

nodes.name: hpcworker
nodes.role: Your own Claude Code as a batch job on a university cluster: the server half of Beethoven, the runner chain that serves GitHub Actions jobs labelled grid as Slurm jobs, the ssh gate, the deployment profiles composed from beethoven-sites.

nodes.name: beethoven-extension
nodes.role: The browser extension over Open OnDemand that starts the worker and hands it to claude.ai: the client half.

nodes.name: beethoven-vscode
nodes.role: Beethoven for VS Code: the wizard, the grid CLI, the access service's keys and the licence tooling.

nodes.name: beethoven-desktop
nodes.role: The desktop edition.

nodes.name: beethoven-base
nodes.role: The shared parsers and rules of the three editions, a pure TypeScript library each edition pulls at a commit and checks against its ORIGIN record.

nodes.name: beethoven-sites
nodes.role: The university site and lab modules: every value that belongs to one cluster or one lab's deployment, from which hpcworker composes each profile.

nodes.name: beethoven-access
nodes.role: The access, licence and report service: one Cloudflare Worker the extension, the VS Code edition and hpcworker reach over HTTP.

nodes.name: beethoven-qa
nodes.role: How code for the engine is written and proven: the definition of done, the contract decorators, the CrossHair/Z3 gate, the code standards and the repository kit consuming repositories carry as a pinned copy.

nodes.name: beethoven-agents
nodes.role: The nested agentic framework of the engine: the Apptainer image, the guard, the accounts and the orchestration of masters, satellites and headless steps as Slurm jobs; qa <- agents <- research.

nodes.name: beethoven-research
nodes.role: The research pipeline of the engine: REFORMS, CLAIM, the studies; the split check the measurement in SchwingNet uses.

nodes.name: chrome-store-release-kit
nodes.role: The reusable release workflow and store upload every extension repository of the owner's calls at main.

nodes.name: Student_Projects
nodes.role: Student research projects on the open datasets: onboarding, templates, tools, the demo study and the ideas list; the projects themselves are in Projects, cloned inside it.

nodes.name: Projects
nodes.role: Student project proposals and work, one folder per project, reviewed by pull request.

nodes.name: Onedrive
nodes.role: The owner's OneDrive organized into projects and notebooks, its catalog on the branch drive-catalog, read through Microsoft Graph under the owner's sign-in.

nodes.name: claude-swap-cloud
nodes.role: cswap, the multi-account switcher for Claude Code with the cloud added, on PyPI as claude-swap-cloud; it writes the session checkpoint block of the Symphony repositories' CLAUDE.md and feeds the token pool's usage.

nodes.name: claude-swap-privacy
nodes.role: The public privacy statement of cswap.

nodes.name: the WSU grid
nodes.role: Wayne State's cluster: the corpora under /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/, the Slurm jobs, hpcworker's runner chain; nothing of its data is ever copied into a repository.

nodes.name: claude.ai
nodes.role: The Claude accounts: Projects and threads on the repositories, the front door artifact, the Claude workflows on subscription tokens, Remote Control on the owner's computer.

nodes.name: Cloudflare
nodes.role: The Workers: the panel's sign-in service (symphony-app) and Beethoven's access service (beethoven-access).

nodes.name: Chrome Web Store
nodes.role: Where the extensions are published through the release kit.

nodes.name: Microsoft 365
nodes.role: The owner's Wayne State OneDrive and Outlook, read through Microsoft Graph under the owner's sign-in: the drive catalog and sync, the Word revisions, the request letters.

nodes.name: Weights and Biases
nodes.role: Where every training run's evaluation is visible, online from the grid or pushed offline by the flow.

nodes.name: the dataset hosts
nodes.role: PhysioNet, Hugging Face, Kaggle, Redivis, Zenodo, Elsevier and the rest: reached from the grid with the keys the template's key route carries, every fetch held to the size rule.

nodes.name: PyPI
nodes.role: Where claude-swap-cloud is published.
